mapper.update: UPDATE room SET code = #{code}, sort = #{sort}, type_name = #{typeName}, floor_id = #{floorId}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, sort, type_name, floor_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM room WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id DESC
SELECT id, code, sort, type_name, floor_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM room WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, code, sort, type_name, floor_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM room WHERE floor_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id DESC
